<script>
(function () {
  var players = [
    { name: "Josh Allen",          pos: "QB", team: "BUF", sal: 8200, proj: 24.8, line: "251 pass yds, 1.9 TD, 36 rush yds" },
    { name: "Christian McCaffrey", pos: "RB", team: "SF",  sal: 8600, proj: 22.1, line: "88 rush yds, 41 rec yds, 1.1 TD" },
    { name: "Puka Nacua",          pos: "WR", team: "LAR", sal: 7400, proj: 19.6, line: "7.4 rec, 96 yds, 0.6 TD" },
    { name: "Brock Bowers",        pos: "TE", team: "LV",  sal: 5900, proj: 14.3, line: "6.1 rec, 64 yds, 0.4 TD" },
    { name: "Jaylen Warren",       pos: "RB", team: "PIT", sal: 4800, proj: 11.2, line: "52 rush yds, 3.2 rec, 0.4 TD" },
    { name: "Jalen McMillan",      pos: "WR", team: "TB",  sal: 3700, proj: 8.4,  line: "3.6 rec, 44 yds, 0.3 TD" }
  ];
  var body = document.getElementById("demo-body");
  if (!body) return;

  // Same color scale as the app: sky (low) -> white -> mint (high)
  var lo = [176, 218, 250], mid = [255, 255, 255], hi = [140, 240, 185];
  function mix(a, b, t) { return a.map(function (v, i) { return Math.round(v + (b[i] - v) * t); }); }
  function color(v, min, max) {
    var t = max === min ? 0.5 : (v - min) / (max - min);
    var c = t < 0.5 ? mix(lo, mid, t * 2) : mix(mid, hi, (t - 0.5) * 2);
    return "rgb(" + c.join(",") + ")";
  }

  function paint() {
    var projs = players.map(function (p) { return p.proj; });
    var min = Math.min.apply(null, projs), max = Math.max.apply(null, projs);
    players.forEach(function (p, i) {
      var row = body.children[i];
      var cell = row.querySelector(".proj");
      cell.style.background = color(p.proj, min, max);
      row.querySelector(".val").textContent = (p.proj / (p.sal / 1000)).toFixed(2) + "x";
    });
  }

  players.forEach(function (p, i) {
    var tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.innerHTML =
      '<td class="l"><span class="pn">' + p.name + '</span><span class="pm">' + p.team + " " + p.pos + '</span><span class="ps">' + p.line + "</span></td>" +
      "<td>$" + p.sal.toLocaleString() + "</td>" +
      '<td class="proj"><input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" inputmode="decimal" aria-label="Projection for ' + p.name + '" value="' + p.proj.toFixed(1) + '"></td>' +
      '<td class="val"></td>';
    body.appendChild(tr);
    var input = tr.querySelector("input");
    input.addEventListener("input", function () {
      var v = parseFloat(input.value);
      players[i].proj = isNaN(v) ? 0 : v;
      tr.classList.add("edited");
      paint();
    });
  });
  paint();
})();
</script>
